reviews.title: More graphics needed
reviews.text:
UPDATED REVIEW! I just opened my app for the first time since I updated. I went to use the AI flyer feature and I found that I now have to have “coins” to use the AI features? I already PAY FOR THE APP! I will not pay real money for something and then have to pay more money to use its features! I’ll be looking for a new app! 

have been using the paid version of this app for about 3 years and in those 3 years, I have yet to notice any sort of updated graphics. The app need many more individual images to use for designing flyers. Such as lines…the lines included in the app only get so small. Things like sports, photography stuff…if you can name it, I guarantee it needs updated graphics. If I have to go to the web more often than I use the built in graphics, why am I paying for this app?

reviews.title: Rip-off
reviews.text: Please do not use this trial! It’s not worth it. Just pay $10 for a flyer. If you use the AI features, you can’t edit the flyer. Then boom before you can remember to cancel, they’ve charged you $42 and all you did was use it for 30 minutes to create one flyer before realizing it’s a waste. Just another American money grab. Buyer beware!

reviews.title: Don’t waste money!
reviews.text: I paid for subscription and only gave me two flyers. It will ask you for more money

reviews.title: Robbed me
reviews.text: I tried the free trial and then canceled it before it ended. Yet they still tried charging me, but because I didn’t have any funds at the time it didn’t go through. Since it didn’t go through, my phone can no longer update or download anymore apps until I pay them. So I gave in and tried paying them anyway, but because the card failed when they tried stealing my money at first, they won’t accept my current payment methods.  Now I can’t do anything until I purchase an Apple gift card and input that payment method into this phone so they can successfully steal my money. SMH. There’s no other options.

reviews.title: My unlimited subscription is no longer unlimited
reviews.text: I purchased a yearly subscription specifically to create flyers and unlimited AI flyers at that.  And I did print unlimited flyers for a brief time but shortly after I purchased the subscription the app must have “updated” and now it is no longer unlimited without additional purchases.  I can make 6 AI a month now I believe.  I definitely am not getting what I paid for at time of purchase and wish I could and would get a refund…or honor what I actually purchased, which is unlimited flyers.  Very disappointed.

reviews.title: Now requires a subscription? :( Uninstalling
reviews.text: I really liked the convenience of being able to design flyers/posters directly on my iPad instead of having to use my laptop to do it, but it now seems to require a subscription which I am not at all interested in having. I have zero interest in the AI features and none of the previous “premium” features were anything I couldn’t do without either. I’ll stick with good old Inkscape on my laptop. I am sorry to see “Flyer Maker” go, it was a nice little tool.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Signed up for the free trial. Was told by the app I would be notified the day before they would charge me for a subscription. They even had a pop up menu appear to confirm I wanted to be notified. Which I confirmed I wanted to be notified. Notification never came. They automatically signed me up for the yearly subscription. Requested a refund. Was denied. Appealed denial stating I was promised a notification before being charged which I never received and was still denied. Be careful this App pretends to care about not charging you if you don’t want a subscription by promising to notify you and then never does and signs you up for the year.

reviews.title: Impossible to use
reviews.text: Pop ups and “helpful hints” appear relentlessly making this app utterly unusable. Keep things simple!

reviews.title: Not for me
reviews.text: I downloaded this to see what it is like. I want only one flyer one time. And it wants me to pay for a yearly membership after 3 days free.  Now I can’t get rid of it.  I find it very deceptive that these apps won’t tell you the cost till after you download them and they want you to review it before you even use it.  So stupid. It wasn’t easy to use. I made my one flyer that I need but I’m worried it is going to charge me for the year with is like $40 I think.  It errors when I try to cancel it.  Don’t download this.
